heading: What happens when you get in touch
intro: Nothing is hidden behind an enquiry. Fees are on this page, in full, including the lower-fee appointments I can sometimes offer if you're on a low income.

items.title: You ring, email or WhatsApp
items.body: Whichever suits you: the number, the address and the WhatsApp link are on this page. Nothing to fill in first.

items.title: We talk about what's going on
items.body: We talk about what you're looking for, what I do, and whether I'm the right person for it.

items.title: We agree a time and a fee
items.body: Session lengths and fees are set out below, in person in MK3 or online.
